assertion_results.text: The skill does NOT silently overwrite or skip the existing value — it waits for user input (Step 4.5.1)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, the existing value is explicitly surfaced ('Affects Version/s is already set: [0.9.0]') and the User Prompt ends with 'Choose (1/2/3):' indicating the skill expects user input before proceeding.
